```
___________________________________________ ERROR at setup of TestHash.test_hash_ipv4 ___________________________________________

self = <test_fib.TestHash instance at 0x7f150403ed88>

        """

        dut_ssh.start()
        logger.info("print self for debug: {}".format(dir(self)))

E       AttributeError: TestHash instance has no attribute 'thresholds'
```

No error.

comments.author: yvolynets-mlnx
comments.body:
This issue will be reproduced only when will be used "--dut_monitor" pytest option.
This is a pytest issue, which was fixed in pytest version 5.1.2.
https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest/issues/2270
https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest/pull/5768

Currently in SONIC setups are used pytest version 4.6.5.
FYI the newest supported pytest version for Python2 is 4.6.10.

Easy solution to workaround this issue is to update test cases.

For example:
- Remove class 'TestHash' and convert its internal methods to a simple functions like it is for 'def test_fib'.
- Create 'timestamp' fixture and use it in: setup_hash, test_hash_ipv4, test_hash_ipv6
instead of 'self.t' call:
@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def timestamp():
    yield datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d-%H:%M:%S')

- Instead of
'hash_keys = HASH_KEYS' and 'self.hash_keys' directly use 'HASH_KEYS'

This approach is tested, tests are running.
